title: Next Steps: Docking, Modern GL & Beyond
summary: Where to go after the capstone: the docking branch and multi-viewports, the OpenGL3 backend, an FBO Game View, ImGuizmo/ImPlot/node editors, imgui.ini persistence, debug tools and a feature checklist for your own engine editor.

options: Switch to the official docking branch (all core + backend files together)
quiz.explain: Docking and multi-viewports live on the docking branch. Replace every core and backend file at once to avoid version mismatches.

quiz.q: You show your scene's FBO colour texture with ImGui::Image and it appears upside down. Fix?
quiz.explain: OpenGL render targets have a bottom-left origin. Flipping V in the UVs is the standard fix.

quiz.q: Which tool helps when a button doesn't respond because of an ID conflict?
quiz.explain: The ID Stack Tool shows the full ID path of the hovered item, so you can spot duplicates quickly.
